title: Spatial neural MRI fitting evaluates glioma-grade discrimination
summary: Spatially aware neural fitting of diffusion MRI was evaluated in 20 previously studied glioma patients with WHO grade references. Attention models estimated intravoxel diffusion and perfusion parameters and were compared with conventional and Bayesian fitting. This small retrospective diagnostic comparison supports a bounded assessment of grade discrimination, rather than a validated clinical grading system or a new mechanism of glioma biology.
organization: University of Zurich; University Children’s Hospital Zurich

evidence.ai_role: Attention networks learn spatially contextual IVIM parameter estimation from simulated signals; estimated parameters are evaluated against patient tumor grades.
